---
title: "UC OSPO Network: Catalog"
---

Talks, workshops, events, lessons, software, papers, and press from the UC OSPO Network, newest first in each section. Each entry links to what is public for it: slides, a handout, source, a DOI, or the event page.

To cite an entry, copy its citation, or download [network-outputs.bib](network-outputs.bib){download="network-outputs.bib"}. BibTeX is a citation format that reference managers such as Zotero import directly. Upcoming meetups are on the [Upcoming events page](https://ucospo.net/events/).

{{< include _outputs-generated.md >}}

## Add or correct an entry

To add an output, fill in the [Add an output form](https://github.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs/issues/new?template=add-output.yml). A maintainer checks it, and approval opens a pull request with the new entry. To correct an entry, open an issue or a pull request on [network-docs](https://github.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs). Entries live in `network-outputs.bib`, and the page rebuilds when the change merges. The header of that file explains the fields.
